description: This file defines the main React component for the 'Career Navigator' Next.js app. It manages the UI flow for uploading documents, initiating persona generation, handling orchestration responses, and managing state transitions throughout the persona creation and finalization process. It also includes logic for handling artifact extraction, updates, and user interactions.

classes.name: Experience
classes.description: Represents a professional experience entry with id, role, company, date, and description.

classes.name: CareerHighlight
classes.description: Represents a career highlight with optional source experience information.

classes.name: PersonaData
classes.description: Models the UI persona data structure including name, title, summary, skills, experiences, education, certificates, tools, industries, years of experience, and career highlights.

classes.name: UploadedFileData
classes.description: Wraps an uploaded File with an id for React state management.

methods.name: asStringArray
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a string array, filtering out non-strings and empty strings.

methods.name: isNonEmptyObject
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a non-null object with at least one own key.

methods.name: getInitials
methods.description: Generates initials from a label string for avatar display.

methods.name: getNestedOrchestrationValue
methods.description: Safely accesses a nested value in an object using a path of keys, returning the value and path.

methods.name: logAvailableKeys
methods.description: Logs the keys present in an object to aid debugging of uncertain payload shapes.

methods.name: extractPersonaJsonFromOrchestrationRecord
methods.description: Extracts persona JSON data from a nested orchestration response, prioritizing certain fields and candidate paths.

methods.name: coercePersonaDataFromBackendJson
methods.description: Transforms backend JSON into the application's PersonaData structure, attempting to map fields and highlights.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main React component managing the full persona creation workflow, document uploads, orchestration handling, and UI state management.

methods.name: handleFileChange
methods.description: Processes file input change events, validates, limits total size and number, and updates React state.

methods.name: handleDrop
methods.description: Handles drag-and-drop file uploads, adding files to upload list.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a specific uploaded file from the upload list.

methods.name: handleGenerateDraft
methods.description: Initiates the persona draft generation process, uploads documents, triggers orchestration, and updates React state based on responses.

methods.name: handleSaveChanges
methods.description: Saves the current persona data to the backend and updates local storage accordingly.

methods.name: handleFinalize
methods.description: Finalizes the persona based on orchestration response, updates backend, and persists final persona.

methods.name: handleRegenerateDraft
methods.description: Requests regeneration of the persona draft, resets relevant state, and updates UI.

methods.name: fingerprintPersonaData
methods.description: Creates a simple string fingerprint of PersonaData for change detection.

methods.name: fingerprintPersonaArtifact
methods.description: Creates a fingerprint string representing the shape and size of the persona JSON artifact.
